coala-runtime's executor images are now published on the GitHub Container Registry, and fetched from there.

## Executor images on ghcr.io

`coala-runtime-python:latest` and `coala-runtime-r:latest` are built and published by GitHub Actions as `ghcr.io/coala-info/coala-runtime-python` and `ghcr.io/coala-info/coala-runtime-r`, for linux/amd64 and linux/arm64, on every `v*` tag (`:<version>` and `:latest`). `coala-runtime --pull`, the Singularity/Apptainer URIs and the on-demand fetch now use those names instead of the Docker Hub copies, and pull anonymously.

## Fetching on first use under xcrunner

The xcrunner extra now requires xcrunner 0.1.7. Earlier versions never applied the published-name mapping when coala-runtime created a container, so an empty image store failed with "could not fetch docker.io/library/coala-runtime-python:latest". With 0.1.7 the image is pulled from ghcr.io and tagged on first use.
